messages:
emily: quick flag for friday KPI review — launch-posts did well (CTR +18%) but dashboard shows inbound routed leads down 22%. can we triage before the sync?

raj: which dashboard tile? weekly -> channel_performance?

emily: yes, filter=launch-q2 and date=last_7_days. impressions/CTR look good but routed leads drop is surprising.

cait: metrics-bot just refreshed the ETL — noted a schema change on the routing table last night.

metrics-bot: ETL refresh complete at 07:02 UTC; routing.lead_events schema change detected: new field session_source_v2 (nullable)

nora: ah that new field breaks the legacy ingestion join we use to map landing UTMs to CRM campaigns. probable loss point.

raj: quick dig — about 160 leads have session_source_v2 populated and session_source is null. our Looker join prefers session_source, so those 160 fall into unknown and don't surface in routed counts.

emily: can we backfill session_source from session_source_v2 in the warehouse for friday's KPIs? small SQL?

cait: yes. prepping a one-time backfill:
```sql
UPDATE marketing.routing_leads
SET session_source = session_source_v2
WHERE session_source IS NULL AND session_source_v2 IS NOT NULL
AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-03-20' AND '2026-03-26';
```

metrics-bot: Backfill job scheduled by cait — job_id bf-346789-01; estimate 18m

ad-ops: heads-up — if those 160 are reassigned to paid, paid CPA will change for last week. we'll need to call that out in the deck.

raj: also found ~40 leads routed but with campaign_name="(none)" — likely landing script sometimes strips utm_campaign for long URLs.

emily: ok add a slide: 1) ingestion gap due to schema change (160), 2) utm_strip edge (40), 3) dedupe variance cookie vs email (~25). be explicit on how numbers affect paid CPA and demo pipeline.

cait: backfill completed — 152 rows updated, 8 failed (null email). bf job id: bf-346789-01 done.

emily: updating KPI tile now. thanks.

metrics-bot: weekly_kpis dashboard updated: "routed leads (post-backfill)" card refreshed by emily at 09:14

ad-ops: added CPA delta estimate to slide notes (+12% last week if 152 assigned to paid). will join friday 9:30 to explain.

emily: perfect. let's keep the slide simple and show remediation steps: landing script fix, server-side session pin, and schema change gating. see you friday.
